retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-inspired layout featuring a warm-toned desert sunset background with a soft-edged portrait overlay and multiline inline display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a red-to-orange sunset gradient over a dark desert silhouette, featuring a large-scale portrait of a man in the lower right and distinctive multiline typography framing the top and left edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait transparency blending into the warm sky background
Typography acting as a frame for the central negative space
Warm color palette unifying the landscape and the subject
Vertical and horizontal text alignment creating a corner frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large portrait positioned in the bottom right quadrant, occupying approximately one-third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow sun glow at the horizon line in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top horizontal text, moves down the vertical text on the left, and settles on the portrait in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the center-left, occupied by the atmospheric sky and clouds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and burnt orange sky tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown or black for the desert silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the sun glow and blue-purple for the text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and oranges with low-value silhouettes for depth.

letterConstructionRules: Each character is composed of three parallel concentric lines
Uniform stroke weight for all lines
Rounded corners on all external and internal turns
characterSpecificRedesigns: O is a perfect concentric circle
W and M feature parallel diagonal strokes that do not cross
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two orientations (horizontal and vertical) to create a structural frame.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s style desert landscape at sunset with a red-orange gradient sky, soft clouds, and a dark mountain silhouette. In the bottom right, blend a soft-edged portrait of a man with dark hair wearing a light-colored collared shirt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom multiline inline lettering in a blue-purple color. Place one line horizontally across the top and one line vertically down the left side, creating a right-angle frame.

verificationChecks: Check that the text is composed of three parallel lines.
Ensure the portrait has a soft, feathered edge blending into the sky.
Verify the color palette is dominated by warm reds and oranges.

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos or specific artist names

mustAchieve: Balanced framing between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Is the typography multiline and rounded?
Does the portrait blend smoothly into the background?
Is the color palette restricted to warm sunset tones?
Is the layout square and balanced?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned atmospheric landscape with a soft-edged subject overlay, framed by geometric multiline display type along the top and left axes.
